topic.title: Installation codes
topic.shortdesc: Share codes with third-party installers to add asset information to your database during the installation.

othermeta.content: Covers installation codes in MyGeotab: generating, editing, and deactivating an installation code.
othermeta.name: aiSearchSummary

body.p: Use the page to view all codes created in your database, including their expiration date, notes, status, and date added. If you hired a third-party installer and are using the Verified installation flow, you will need to generate an install code. You do not need an install code when performing the installation yourself or through a Geotab Trusted Installer. If you're not sure if you need a code, refer to Installation overview.
